cycle_position.summary: The tightest asset class in CRE: North America primary-market vacancy 1.6%; 74.3% of capacity under construction is pre-leased; pricing at all-time highs, and large AI deployments now pay PREMIUMS for scale where they once got volume discounts. The binding constraint is power delivery, not capital, land, or demand — power gates development timelines and suppresses speculative build.

cap_rate_ranges.note: No clean 2026 cap-rate band surfaced in snippet coverage; deals are bespoke (powered-shell vs turnkey vs hyperscale build-to-suit).

supply_demand.value: 1.6% primary vacancy; 74.3% of under-construction capacity pre-leased; power-gated pipeline.

debt_terms.value: Institutional/private-credit territory; not a small-balance market.

small_investor_verdict.entry_vehicle: REIT shares (or nothing). The only physical-asset adjacency at $1-2M: land near substations/fiber in Northern Virginia's expansion corridors — a speculative land play, not a data-center play.
small_investor_verdict.reasoning: Minimum viable direct ticket is two orders of magnitude above budget. The NoVA land adjacency overlaps the buyer's home turf and is worth tracking through the intel watches (Loudoun/PW data-center-alley rezonings move dirt prices), but it belongs in the land/infill bucket.

gaps: PW County data-center overlay district changes (feeds the land thesis)
